operation_items.operation: close from the target, exclude satisfied nodes, emit in order
prune at depth and keep the closure minimal
a target outside the relation is rejected
reject an inconsistent cycle and name its closing node

prompt_intro:
`minimal_recompute` must return the outputs that have to be recomputed to
obtain `target`, in dependency order, with each output appearing once and
with outputs in `known` omitted (and their dependencies pruned). If `target`
is already known, return an empty plan. If the target has no rule and is not
known, return `Err(PlanError::Unknown(target))`. If the dependency closure
contains a cycle, return `Err(PlanError::Cycle(node))` with the node that
closes the cycle. Ties are broken by the order rules are declared.

shared_operation.audit: author annotation only; no inter-annotator agreement yet (P11.21 gap)
shared_operation.definition: Given a target, build its dependency relation, close it from the required node while excluding already-satisfied nodes, reject a cycle as an error, and emit the minimal set of declarations to change in dependency order.
shared_operation.name: dependency-closure minimal repair
shared_operation.transfer_rule: A trio win requires success on every surface with the per-surface breakdown reported; a pooled or single-surface gain is not transfer.
